criteria.description: the lead must decelerate at the authored rate, not merely be slow
criteria.reason: the rubric vocabulary has no criterion over another actor's deceleration profile

originalIntent: Euro NCAP AEB Car-to-Car Rear (CCRs stationary / CCRb braking) protocol: the conflict is a closing rear-end with a decelerating or stationary lead. A rear-end scenario in which TTC never falls below ~2.5 s is a following manoeuvre, not a conflict. Bands are pre-registered from published test protocols, not fitted to observed results.
title: Rear-end conflict with a lead vehicle: the ego must face a genuine stopping demand and stop short
